responsibility: Declares the top-level NameResolution driver for the Rust frontend’s AST resolver. This small interface exposes the singleton-style entry point that resolves an entire crate and encapsulates the shared Resolver and Mappings state used to set up global scopes and run the module’s multi-pass item and expression/type resolution pipeline.
same_name_distinction: Declares the NameResolution class and its public crate entry point, private go method, constructor, and stored Resolver/Mappings pointers, but does not perform any resolution work itself. It differs from rust-ast-resolve.cc by providing only the small interface for the crate-level driver.
